stories.title: Consent Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define canonical consent data schema including tier (1/2), timestamp, session linkage, de-identification flag, and audit metadata. Standardize contract used across services and APIs.

stories.title: Consent Persistence and Audit Logging
stories.description: Implement storage of consent decisions with full audit trail, including tier selection, changes over time, and linkage to session/user identifiers. Ensure compatibility with debug logger and MongoDB utilities.

stories.title: Consent Framework Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for consent tier logic, de-identification enforcement, and schema validation, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow across API, services, and storage.
